summary: Romgaz, Romania's largest gas producer, posted third-quarter net profit of 482 million lei, down 36.2% year on year, despite a 1% rise in revenue. Higher taxes were the main pressure.
why: Romgaz is a state-controlled gas producer and one of the largest listed companies on the Bucharest Stock Exchange, so its results signal the impact of Romanian energy taxation.
